## The problem

What is hard, missing, or surprising today. Describe the situation before the
solution.

## The change you would like

What you would like Qala, the CLI, or the playground to do instead.

## Alternatives you considered

Other ways to solve the same problem, and why the proposed change is better.

## Additional context

Anything else: a sketch of the syntax, a link to how another language handles
it, or an example program.
